The pie - chart shows percentage - wise distribution of teachers who teach six different subjects. Study the pie chart and answer the question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9f4c22cc0fce0cf761ba12a3c0eea3cfcbab513575a95b9d73d11bbffc07adc.png] 

Total number of teachers = 1650

What is the total number of teachers teaching English, Maths and Physics?
questions.solution:
From Pie chart,

⇒ English teacher = 26% of total number of teacher 

⇒ (26/100) × 1650 = 429

⇒ Maths teacher = 14% of total number of teacher 

⇒ (14/100) × 1650 = 231

⇒ Physics teacher = 18% of total number of teacher 

⇒ (18/100) × 1650 = 297

⇒ Total number of teacher of English, Maths and Physics = 429 + 231 + 297 = 957

∴ Total number of teachers teaching English, Maths and Physics is 957

questions.question: If 8 - digit number 4432A43B is divisible by 9 and 5, then the sum of A and B is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Number = 4432A43B

**Concept used **

divisibility rule of 9 = sum of all digit should be divisible by 9, then whole number will be divide by 9 

divisibility rule of 5 = unit digit should be 0 and 5 , whole number will be divide by 5

**Calculation **

⇒ according to rule of divisibility of 5 , then B = 0 or 5 

⇒ sum of digit when B = 0, sum = 4 + 4 + 3 + 2 + A + 4 + 3 + 0 = 20 + A

⇒ sum of digit , when B = 5 , sum = 4 + 4 + 3 + 2 + A + 4 + 3 + 5 = 25 + A

⇒ we need sum of digit is 27 to divide by 9 

⇒ so, sum A and B = 7

questions.question: A train covers a distance of 2 km in 2 minutes. If its speed is decreased by 5 km/h, then the time taken by it to cover the distance of 22 km will be:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Train cover distance in 2 minutes = 2 km 

**Formula Used **

Speed = Distance/time 

**Calculation **

⇒ Actual speed of train = (2/2) × 60 = 60 km/hr 

⇒ Speed of train decreases by = 5 km/hr

⇒ Now speed of train = 55 km/hr 

⇒ Time taken by train to cover 22 km = (22/55) × 60 = 24 minutes 

∴ Time taken by train to cover 22 km is 24 minutes

questions.question:
The following bar chart represents the birth rate (per thousand) of six different countries. Study the bar chart and answer the question given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f4738c25414276838e09c5fbca74cd46f7c00e8a2ccd28f9101ae81fffddd18.png] 

The birth rate of country E is what per cent of the birth rate of the Country A?
questions.solution:
From the Bar Graph

⇒ Birth rate of country A = 20/thousand

⇒ Birth rate of country E = 36/thousand

⇒ Percentage = (birth rate of country E)/(birth rate of country A) × 100 

⇒ Percentage = (36/20) × 100 = 180%

∴ The Birth rate of country E is 180% of birth rate of country A

questions.question: The average of A, B and C is 18 and that of C, D and E is 12 and that of E and F is 6.5 and that of E and C is 3.5. What is the average of A, B, C, D, E and F?
questions.solution:
**Given **

The average of A, B and C = 18 years 

The average of C, D and E = 12 years 

**Formula Used **

Average = (sum of observation)/(No. of observation)

**Calculation **

⇒ Total age of A, B and C = 18 × 3 = 54 -----(i)

⇒ Total age of C, D and E = 12 × 3 = 36 ------(ii)

⇒ E + F = 13 ---(iii)

⇒ E + C = 7 ----(iv)

⇒ from iii and iv 

⇒ F - C = 6 -----(v) 

⇒Adding (i), (ii) and (v) 

⇒ A + B + C + C + D + E + F - C = 54 + 36 + 6 

⇒ A + B + C + D + E + F = 96 

⇒ the average = 96/6 = 16 

∴ the average of A, B, C, D, E and F is 16 years

questions.question: When an article is sold for Rs. 720, there is a profit of x%. When the same article is sold for Rs. 750, profit is (x + 5)%. What is the value of is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given **

Selling price of article at x% profit = Rs 720 

Selling price of article at (x + 5)% profit = Rs 750 

**Formula Used **

Profit % = (profit/cp) × 100 

Profit = sp - cp 

**Calculation **

⇒ difference in profit = 5% 

⇒ [(750 - cp)/cp] - [(720 - cp)/cp] = 5/100

⇒ 30/cp = 5/100 

⇒ cp = Rs 600 

⇒ x = (720 - 600)/600 × 100 

⇒ x = 20% 

∴ the value of x is 20

questions.question: A discount of 30% on the marked price of a book enables Arun to get a pen worth Rs. 60 free. How much did Arun pay for the book?

Pen cost price = Rs 60 

Discount = 30% of marked price of book

Discount% = (discount/marked price) × 100

selling price = marked price - discount 

**Calculation **

⇒ according to Question 

⇒ 30% of x = 60 

⇒ x = Rs 200

⇒ so, selling price of book = 200 - 60 = Rs 140

questions.question: A sum of money amounts to Rs. 7,500 in 5 years, and to Rs. 8,500 in 7 years at simple interest at the same rate of interest. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Amount after 5 years = Rs 7500

Amount after 7 years = Rs 8500

**Formula Used **

Simple Interest = principal × rate × time/100

Amount = Principal + (n) S.I { n = no. of years)

**Calculation**

Let the principal and simple interest for one year be x and y respectively 

⇒ 7500 = x + 5y -----(i)

⇒ 8500 = x + 7y ------(ii) 

⇒ Substract eq (ii) and (i) 

⇒ 2y = 1000 

⇒ y = 500

⇒ Put the value of y in eq (i) 

⇒ x = 5000 

⇒ 500 = 5000 × r × 1/100 

⇒ r = 10% 

∴ the rate of interest per annum is 10%

questions.question: Bala decided to donate 10% of his salary to PM Care Fund. On the day of donation, he changed his mind and donated Rs. 1,800 which was 60% of what he had decided earlier. How much is his salary?
questions.solution:
**Given **

Bala donated money = Rs 1800

**Formula Used **

Percentage = (required/actual) × 100 

**Calculation **

⇒ Let the Bala's salary is 100x 

⇒ he decide to donate his salary = 10% of 100x = 10x 

⇒But, he donate money = 60% of 10x = 6x 

⇒ 6x = Rs1800 

⇒ x = 300

⇒ 100x = 100 × 300 = Rs 30000

∴ the Bala's salary is Rs 30000
